events.content:
I want a small app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.
I'll look at the workspace first, then build a small book tracker that stores books in a JSON file and supports shareable book links.
The workspace only has a package file so far. I'll check that and the eval folder so the app matches whatever is already set up.
There's a test runner already. I'll check how the eval harness expects the app to work before writing anything.

args.content:
# Reading list

A small app for tracking books you are reading and books you have finished. There are no accounts. Books are stored in `data/books.json`, so they stay put across restarts.

## Run

```bash
npm start
```

Open http://localhost:3000.

Set `PORT` to change the port, or `BOOKS_FILE` to store the JSON somewhere else.

## What you can do

- See currently reading and finished books on the home page.
- Add a book with a title, author, and notes.
- Open a book at `/books/<id>` to see its title, author, and notes. That URL is the link you can send someone.
- Mark a current book as finished from its page.

The reading list is a small Node app with no accounts. Books are stored in data/books.json, so they stay after a restart.

Run npm start and open http://localhost:3000. The home page shows what you are currently reading and what you have finished, plus a form to add a title, author, and notes.
